Former Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang today said he’s open to returning to his old post. Huang expressed his willingness to be reinstated in a post on X. It marks his first public statement since his ouster from Nvidia last week. He resigned following revelations that he had an affair with Alice Huang, […]
